draft.subject: Sunlit pheras, a sister's wedding
draft.preheader: Gold for the morning ceremony and the dance floor after.
draft.body:
Your sister's wedding starts in sunlight, so begin with the ears. {p1} are brass dipped in gold, swimming fish that curve round the ear and end in amethyst beads.

For the neck, {p2} is a classic string of pearls with a single emerald at the centre, so it sits quietly under silk and still finds the light.

{p3} are reversible hoops in antique gold, studded with glass on both sides, for the hour when the ceremony turns to music.
